chunks: Although Moses had come to you with evidence of the truth, you chose the calf in his absence, and you transgressed.
ai.seo_question: What did the Israelites do after Prophet Moses brought them clear proofs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Israelites' 'self-injustice' (dhulm) by prioritizing immediate sensory gratification over the enduring truth of Moses' (AS) prophethood. It serves as a paradigmatic example of how clear evidence (bayyinat) can be rejected due to spiritual negligence, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate the fragility of faith amidst divine trials.
